Perfect Loop uses the unmodified single-thread @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10.
Its JavaScript and WebAssembly assets are copied directly from that pinned npm package.

Package source/build project:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/main/packages/core
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/main/src
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/main/build
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/main/Dockerfile
https://ffmpegwasm.netlify.app/docs/contribution/

The bundled core package declares version 0.12.10 and
GPL-2.0-or-later. Its Dockerfile and build scripts identify and fetch the
FFmpeg and codec/library sources used to build the core. The core includes
GPL components such as x264; its license is separate from the MIT JavaScript wrapper.

Original FFmpeg source:
https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git

No modifications were made to the core JavaScript or WebAssembly binary.
The WebAssembly binary is stored losslessly as gzip and decoded in the browser.
Component licenses: see GPL-2.txt and the application THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
